title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.1 command injection was possible in untrusted projects via Tomcat run…
description: A command injection vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.1 when using Tomcat run configurations on Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) in untrusted projects. This flaw could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the affected process.
